title: Executive Support Officer
description:
Summary
The Executive Office Support Officer provides high-level administrative support to the Executive Office Team Leader and the executive team. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion, and a proactive approach to managing a wide range of administrative tasks. The role includes delegating specific tasks to conveyancing support, handling license and permit applications, and supporting special projects and initiatives within the department and across other departments.
Duties and Responsibilities
Administrative Support:
Manage the executive’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Coordinate and manage executive team meetings, including preparing agendas, taking minutes, and following up on action items.
Communication:
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications on behalf of the executive office.
Screen and direct phone calls, emails, and other communications to appropriate parties.
Maintain and update contact lists and databases.
Project Management:
Assist with the planning and execution of special projects and events within the department and across other departments.
Track project timelines and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are met.
Conduct research and compile data to support executive decision-making.
Office Management:
Maintain office supplies and equipment, ensuring the executive office is well-stocked and operational.
Organize and maintain electronic and paper files, ensuring confidentiality and easy access.
Coordinate with IT and facilities teams to address any office-related issues.
Travel Coordination:
Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, and transportation.
Prepare detailed travel itineraries and ensure all travel documents are in order.
Confidentiality and Discretion:
Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion.
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, particularly concerning data protection and confidentiality.
Delegation of Work:
Delegate tasks to conveyancing support staff, ensuring clear instructions and deadlines.
Oversee the progress of delegated tasks, providing guidance and support as needed.
Ensure the completion of delegated tasks in a timely and accurate manner.
License and Permit Applications:
Handle the preparation and submission of license and permit applications.
Track the status of applications and follow up as necessary.
Maintain records of all applications and relevant documentation.
Special Projects and Initiatives:
Support the planning and execution of special projects and initiatives within the department.
Collaborate with other departments to support cross-departmental projects and initiatives.
Provide administrative support for strategic initiatives led by the executive team.
Departmental Support:
Assist other departments with administrative tasks as needed.
Coordinate with various departments to ensure smooth communication and collaboration.
Support departmental events, meetings, and activities.
Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in an executive support or similar administrative role.
Skills:
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
Professional demeanor and ability to work with high-level executives.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Others
Competencies:
Proactivity:
Anticipate the needs of the executive team and act accordingly.
Discretion:
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with care.
Flexibility:
Adapt to changing priorities and work under pressure.
Interpersonal Skills:
Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
